profiler.note: Primary MI308X GEMM route: run rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events so raw ROCm PM counter tracks and kernel dispatch slices share one Perfetto proto, then pair each dispatch to its counter sample by same-run/same-dispatch start timestamp within a declared tolerance. ROCm PM evidence is per dispatch; there is no periodic PM sampling equivalent to nsys at 200 kHz. rocprofv3 MfmaUtil is optional independent calibration/fallback only. Optional amd-smi polling is coarse debug context and is never compute or memory utilization.

platform_note: MI308X is gfx942 with wave64 (80 CUs, 4 XCCs). Use 128x128x16 4-wave64 MFMA tile geometry (256 CTAs for 2048x2048, <= 4 concurrent CTAs/CU on 80 CUs instead of 4,096 tiny 32x32 CTAs), single-16B AoS global_store_dwordx4 in fi_lite_hip.h (FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED) with s_memrealtime (100 MHz) and hoisted overflow atomicOr in fi_close, 12-buffer cold-HBM ring (3.2% warm L2 vs 13.2% cold HBM), and Rendering Contract R6 pid=1 / upid=1 / sort_index=-1000 topmost [0-100%] hardware utilization.

evidence_summary.scope: Per-semantic statuses describe the availability of target-specific evidence for ISA/recorder guidance; MI308X gfx942 is measured with 128x128x16 4-wave64 MFMA tile geometry, single-16B global_store_dwordx4, and 12-buffer cold-HBM ring.

supporting_evidence: 128x128x16 4-wave64 MFMA tile geometry (256 CTAs for 2048x2048, <= 4 concurrent CTAs/CU on 80 CUs)
mfma.guidance: gfx942 tensor work is MFMA-based. Size GEMM tiles to 128x128x16 across 4 wave64s (256 threads/CTA) so 2048x2048 launches 256 CTAs (<= 4 CTAs/CU across 80 CUs) and verify emitted v_mfma forms in AMDGCN.

supporting_evidence: lane-0 record predicate must use lane==0 or threadIdx.x&63==0
single-16B AoS global_store_dwordx4 + s_memrealtime (100 MHz) + hoisted overflow atomicOr in fi_close
wave64.guidance: Never reuse NVIDIA warp32 masks or lane arithmetic. A HIP wave64 recorder has one logical lane-0 writer per wave; use FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED single-16B AoS global_store_dwordx4 and hoist overflow atomicOr to fi_close.

recorder.api_family: FI_B / FI_E / FI_M / FI_BG_PRED / FI_EG_PRED / FI_OPEN / FI_CLOSE
recorder.open_close: FI_OPEN installs the lane/wave/CTA recorder predicate; FI_CLOSE is required on every executed exit path and hoists the overflow atomicOr out of the K-loop.
fits: ABI tag fields must match the selected recorder. Do not invent a new event layout in the recipe.
notes: Use one logical begin/end pair per selected semantic interval.

Pillar I & II (v14 <= 10% perturbation engine): Single-16B AoS global_store_dwordx4 in fi_lite_hip.h with s_memrealtime (100 MHz), FI_BG_PRED / FI_EG_PRED, L2-isolated host fi_reset, and hoisted overflow atomicOr in fi_close avoids K-loop basic-block bloat.

Pillar III & IV: Use 12-buffer cold-HBM ring (As[12], Bs[12]) during hardware capture (revealing 13.2% cold-HBM bandwidth vs 3.2% warm-L2), closed-loop stride selection S in {full(1), stride4(4), stride8(8)} enforcing Measured_Overhead(S*) <= 10.0% (G5), and Rendering Contract R6 (pid=1 / upid=1 / sort_index=-1000 topmost [0-100%] hardware utilization, verified by fi_trace_gate.py G1-G5).
Keep aux stable between pair members so waits and phases can be correlated.
The device recorder can only carry a 32-bit aux; move larger descriptors to names.json or the capture metadata.

source_recognition_policy.resolution: Assign a semantic ID only after reading the enclosing dataflow and the operator/task boundary.

correctness_hazards: AMDGCN/ISA disturbance: instrumentation and surrounding code motion can change instruction count, register allocation, spills, vector width, and the selected tensor-core or copy family. Compile FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 and compare the final AMDGCN.
Divergence/mask: a recorder in a divergent branch can produce unpaired records or deadlock a barrier. Preserve the original predicate and use the target wave size for lane selection.
Buffer overflow: fixed slots can fill or point out of range. Require the device overflow bits to be zero, records per lane to stay below cap, and no ring/wrap behavior.

Asynchronous completion: global-to-LDS loads counted by vmcnt, LDS/scalar accesses counted by lgkmcnt, MFMA completion, and collectives have issue and completion boundaries that are not interchangeable.
Correctness drift: moving code across predicates, fences, or waits can change numerical results or visibility even when the kernel still runs.
validation_requirements: Parse all JSON and validate this document against configs/validation/schemas/recipe.schema.json.
Use only semantic IDs present in configs/semantic_ids.json; display names must exactly equal their IDs.
Compile off, entry-only, and full builds with Python 3.10 orchestration where applicable; compare final AMDGCN and register/spill metrics.
Run full-output correctness against an uninstrumented reference with tail, mask, dtype, and shape cases for the selected operator.
Verify cap, slot count, records per lane, overflow bits, and trace completeness.

Capture the selected hardware evidence with same-run rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events and pair raw PM counters to dispatch slices by same-dispatch start timestamp in the same Perfetto proto. Use rocprofv3 only as an explicitly labeled fallback/calibration when the primary route is unavailable or incompatible. Keep MI308X gfx942 evidence separate and retain the canonical card-mi308x token in final trace and receipt filenames.

semantics.description: Row max, exponentiation, normalization, or another softmax subtask.
source_recognition: row_max / expf or exp2 / row_sum normalization
online-softmax running maximum and denominator rescaling
warp or CTA reduction followed by normalized probability writeback
attention score stabilization before probabilities feed the value product

placement.begin: Immediately before the selected row max, exponentiation, or normalization step for the score tile.
placement.end: After the normalized probabilities are ready for their consumer; use one matching interval per selected softmax subtask.
placement.async_completion_caveat: Softmax itself has no asynchronous completion boundary. If it consumes asynchronously loaded scores, begin only after the matching wait makes those scores visible and account for the wait separately.
